responsibility: Declares minimal internal debugging facilities for the gm2 compiler: an assertion primitive that turns failed invariants into internal compiler errors, and a conditional debug-text writer controlled by compiler debugging options. It is the lightweight front-end contract for ad hoc invariant checking rather than user diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition module for M2Debug: it only publishes the two debugging entry points, `Assert` and `WriteDebug`, as the interface seen by other gm2 compiler modules. The paired `M2Debug.mod` contains the actual behavior, including calling `M2Error.InternalError` on failed assertions and checking `M2Options.CompilerDebugging` before emitting text.
